content_blocks.label: clause_1._DEFINITIONS
content_blocks.text: ‘Confidential Information’ means all information disclosed by Disclosing Party to Receiving Party that is marked as confidential or that, given its nature, should reasonably be understood to be confidential.

content_blocks.label: clause_2.1_OBLIGATIONS
content_blocks.text: Receiving Party shall maintain the confidentiality of Confidential Information and shall not disclose it to any third party without the prior written consent of Disclosing Party.

content_blocks.label: clause_3.1_TERM
content_blocks.text: This NDA shall remain in effect until the expiration of three (3) years from the date of disclosure of Confidential Information.

content_blocks.label: notary_note
content_blocks.text: Sworn before me this 27th day of September 2024.
